reproduction: Reviewed and executed only notebook setup, preprocessing, model definitions, evaluation helpers, and final validation call. No CV, test submission generation, or train+validation refit was run.
protocol_difference: Ani fits scaler/PCA/GMM on all train/validation/test embeddings without validation/test labels; our scalers/clustering use training rows only. Ani refits the submitted classifier with validation labels; our prepared current candidate does not.
cv_note: The repeated-CV result is distinct from the held-out 78-trial validation score and should not be compared directly with our validation F1.
